text: 10 minutes daily without a phone: sit on the floor, let him lead the play. He points to something? Say its name. He makes a sound? Imitate it. He smiles? Smile back at him. Presence builds secure attachment (al-ta’alluq al-amin).

review_defects.english: He makes a sound? Imitate it.
review_defects.why: The Arabic imperative 'قلّده' means 'imitate him' (the child), not 'imitate it' (the sound). The English shifts the object from the child to the sound, slightly altering the focus of the instruction.
